 Order

Date : 05.01.2026 (M. Zothankhuma, J) Heard Mr. S. N. Tamuli, learned counsel for the applicant,
who submits that there is a delay of 226 days in filing the appeal against the conviction of the applicant under Section 376(3) and 366 IPC.
Ms. B. Bhuyan, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam submits that she has got no objection to the delay being condoned.
On considering the submissions of the learned counsels for the parties, the delay of 226 days is condoned.
Registry to register the connected appeal and list the same thereafter.
I.A. is accordingly allowed and disposed of.
